stances.summary: Emphasizes ongoing atrocities and human rights violations in post-Assad Syria
stances.quote: Three months after Assad’s fall Syrians are still unearthing new horrors. The latest: bodies in the basements of buildings in towns reconquered by the regime. Chilling reporting by @leloveluck & Zakaria Zakaria with amazing photos by @salwangeorges www.washingtonpost.com/world/20

stances.summary: Frames sanctions lifting as enabling Syrian recovery and public celebration
stances.quote: Incredible scenes in Syria as people celebrate the surprise lifting of US sanctions, the chief impediment to recovery after the fall of Assad. “There were fireworks over Damascus, and people danced in the streets.” Over to the Syrians. By @leloveluck www.washingtonpost.com/world/

stances.summary: Highlights Trump administration engagement on missing journalist; implies Biden inaction
stances.quote: Debra Tice says Trump’s team has already reached out to offer help to find her son Austin, missing in Syria since 2012. “I haven’t experienced that for the last four years” she told journalists in Damascus, a dig at Biden. By @leloveluck www.washingtonpost.com/world/2025/0...

stances.summary: Expresses optimism that Assad's fall enables recovery of missing U.S. journalist
stances.quote: Debra Tice, mother of missing U.S. journalist Austin Tice, has arrived in Beirut en route to Syria to join in the search for him. Let’s hope that he will soon be found now that Assad has gone

stances.summary: Warns against external powers interfering in Syria's future
stances.quote: @lizsly.bsky.social on the dangers of growing outsider posturing to have a say in Syria's future wapo.st/4ffuszH

stances.summary: Reports escalating war fears; characterizes tension as most serious in recent history
stances.quote: The US has authorized the departure of dependents & non-essential personnel from embassies and bases within striking distance of Iran amid fears that Israel will soon attack Iran. “We think it’s more serious than any time in the past” a diplomat told the Post www.washingtonpost.c

stances.summary: Highlights Trump's expired Iran nuclear deadline and implicit threat of bombing
stances.quote: Also worth noting that Trump’s 60-day deadline for Iran to reach a nuclear deal expired on Wednesday. If there’s no deal by then, “there will be bombing” Trump said back in April. He didn’t say it would be US bombing.

stances.summary: Multiple Middle East escalations indicate serious regional conflict risk
stances.quote:
UPDATE:
• US evacuating personnel in Iraq

• < 24hrs after Iran threat to hit US bases
• Trump losing confidence in deal

stances.summary: Warns Israeli escalation policy risks endless regional warfare
stances.quote: Israel says it needs to prepare for a potential war with Turkey & sees the new Sunni government in Syria  as potentially a “greater threat” than Iran. Israel needs a policy of “eliminating threats entirely and maximising response”. Setting up the region for endless wars

stances.summary: Hezbollah facing internal crisis amid shifting support
stances.quote: "Hizbullah gaslit us!" Supporters are cursing it, opponents sense an opportunity. @lizsly.bsky.social profiles the most successful militia in the world as it hits an existential crossroad www.economist.com/1843/2025/05...

stances.summary: Syria undergoing rapid transformation with mixed emotions
stances.quote:
Reflections from Syria. Very briefly, for now. Lots more to come in the days/weeks ahead.

Three things are happening at once:
1/ The joy, relief, and miracle of it all.
2/ The huge grief and horror. 
3/ The uncertainty, complexity, and huge work ahead.

stances.summary: Syrian activist killed at end of Assad regime
stances.quote:
"That he had survived all this time under the terrible conditions only to be killed at the very end is one of the hardest things for his friends to bear... [But] he died a hero" 
Sarah Afshar on death of Syrian activist Mazen al-Hamada.

By @lizsly.bsky.social:
www.washingtonpost

stances.summary: Highlights Assad regime's mass disappearances as permanent tragedy
stances.quote: The joy felt by millions of Syrians at Assad’s departure has been tempered by the realization that most of the estimated 100,000 people who went missing in the gulag of his prison system will probably never return. — @lizsly.bsky.social www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/1...

stances.summary: Signals Trump Greenland acquisition efforts are serious threat, not dismissible
stances.quote: Danish officials are being warned by Trump advisers & allies that he is “much more serious” about acquiring Greenland than he was in his first term. This time, the threat can’t be dismissed https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/08/politics/danish-officials-trump-greenland/index.html
